Route 110
Route 110 110ばんどうろ		TrainersPokemonItems
North Exit: Mauville City
South Exit: Slateport City
West Exit: Route 103
Access To: New Mauville

Route 110 is a long route between Mauville City and Slateport City. It has two ways to travel through it. First is the Cycling Road, which gives a straight path but has numerous trainers to contend with. Alternatively, there's a zig-zagged path with wild Pokémon that follows a similar route. Inside the route, there is also the entrance to New Mauville as well as the Trick House.

Trick House
The Trick House is a building which opens up various puzzles containing trainers as you earn more badges. When you complete each room, you'll receive various prizes of items and decorations for the Secret Base

Special Moves used in Route 110:
Surf
